verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a natural-language interface through its AI SRE. Users can ask for recent logs or charts in natural language, chat online, tag @betterstack in Slack, or reach it via its MCP server in Claude Code. Its approval-gated actions imply some operational capability, but the documented scope centers on querying and investigation rather than broadly operating the product. Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language configuration and management (e.g., creating monitors, schedules, or status pages by command), detail on which actions the AI can execute, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Get recent logs or chart visualizations by simply asking in natural language.
Chat online, inside Slack and in Claude Code using the MCP
Discussing an incident in Slack? Call the AI SRE simply by tagging @betterstack.
The AI SRE suggests hypotheses but never takes any automated actions without your approval.
